title: Personal probe log — micro-batch ops
body:
Purpose:
Quick personal ledger for micro-batching experiments, heuristics to try, and lightweight run history. Meant as a fleeting scratchsheet I update between runs/standups. Not canonical; migrate winners to /shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime when stable.

Format notes (columns): date | run_tag | model | seed | batch_mode | batch_size | prefix_cache | quant | p50_ms | p95_ms | tokens_in | tokens_out | est_cost_per_1k | notes
---
2026-03-10 | pb-130 | rwv2-7B-fp16 | 42 | adaptive | 16 | enabled | 4-bit | 82 | 180 | 1200 | 3200 | $0.45 | good throughput, token drop at sequence>1k, need KV eviction tuning
2026-03-10 | pb-131 | rwv2-7B-q8 | 42 | fixed | 32 | disabled | 8-bit | 120 | 320 | 900 | 2400 | $0.28 | cheaper but p95 spikes when mixed-size requests queued
2026-03-09 | pb-127 | llama2-13B-ggml | 7 | adaptive | 8 | enabled | 16-bit | 160 | 420 | 2200 | 5600 | $0.76 | memory thrash on long seq, try sticky-KV policy
2026-02-28 | pb-099 | rwv2-3B | 11 | burst | 64 | disabled | fp16 | 55 | 110 | 400 | 1200 | $0.32 | good for short completion patterns, batch scheduling tuned to 40ms
2026-02-25 | pb-087 | rwv2-7B-fp16 | 13 | adaptive | 24 | partial | 4-bit | 95 | 210 | 1500 | 3800 | $0.40 | kernel choice A better on A100, kernel B on 80GB p4 seems worse

Quick heuristics tried (notes):
- adaptive batch: start small, grow if CPU idle < 20ms; helps short-latency SLOs but adds jitter at high qps.
- sticky-KV: keep KV pinned per session id for 30s; reduces recompute for chat-style traffic. Memory growth observed past 30min, need eviction policy.
- quant fallback: dual-model routing to q8 fallback when capacity constrained; reduces p95 but adds routing overhead.

Open questions / TODOs:
- test prefix-cache disabled + larger batch to see effect on tail latency (ticket JIRA-OPS-4521).
- add a column for GPU-util% and memory-committed next run.
- try seed stability sweep (seeds 1..20) on pb-130 to evaluate cost variance.
- synth traffic: craft 3 patterns: short-chat(<=64), doc-extend(512-1500), multi-turn(5x128).

Ad-hoc checklist (for next run):
- [ ] enable perf counter collection (nightly-sampler)
- [ ] set trace_limit to 200 for runs > 1k tokens
- [ ] attach payload sample and prompt_id to run metadata

Raw prompt snippets (for repro):
- short-chat: "Summarize latest release notes in 3 bullets. Tone: upbeat."
- doc-extend: "Continue the draft technical spec below; preserve headers, add one diagram note."
- multi-turn: simulated user messages + assistant responses in alternating sequence (seeded).

Notes to self: keep this file lean. When I have a stable config with consistent p95 < SLA, copy to shared_drives/engineering/observability and open PR for rollout runbook.

End of sheet.
